Explore European destinations and discover tips for your journey

 

Discover some of the most inspiring European destinations and start planning your next journey across the continent. Thanks to flights to Europe operated by Air Dolomiti, travellers can easily reach cities rich in art, culture and local traditions. Travelling across Europe means discovering an architectural and cultural heritage unlike anywhere else.

 

Your journey might begin in Germany, where Munich fascinates visitors with landmarks such as the Frauenkirche and the lively Marienplatz, the historic heart of the city. Moving east, the Czech Republic welcomes travellers to Prague, with the famous Charles Bridge and the impressive Prague Castle. A little further north, Poland reveals centuries of history in Kraków, home to the elegant Wawel Castle overlooking the old town.

 

For travellers looking for timeless elegance, France and Italy remain essential stops. Lyon captivates visitors with its historic center and renowned culinary traditions, while Verona showcases Roman heritage with the Arena di Verona and its medieval squares. Nearby Bologna invites travellers to explore its historic porticoes and the famous Towers of Bologna. Further south, Florence preserves Renaissance masterpieces such as the Florence Duomo and the world-famous Galleria degli Uffizi, while Bari on the Adriatic coast is known for its historic old town and traditional dishes such as tiella barese.

 

Equally fascinating is Luxembourg, known for its impressive UNESCO-listed fortifications, while England offers iconic cities such as London, where landmarks like the Tower of London and the British Museum stand alongside contemporary architecture. 

 

Air Dolomiti destinations offer countless opportunities to discover Europe!
